claim_text: Lordstown has approximately 100,000 pre-orders for the Endurance pickup truck
Lordstown's Endurance is a production-ready vehicle scheduled for delivery in late 2021
Lordstown owns and operates the former GM Lordstown Assembly plant (6.2M sq ft) for production
Lordstown has proprietary in-wheel hub motor technology that enables the Endurance
Lordstown has commercial fleet customer commitments from named operators (E-Squared, Hotwire, Hot Lync)
Lordstown received a $40M secured loan from GM as part of strategic partnership; GM committed to provide certain components
Steve Burns and other insiders are aligned with shareholders (implied by S-4 / lock-up disclosures)
Lordstown's pre-orders represent serious customer commitments for the Endurance program
